gloss: small accessory case; trinket box; catch-all container

definitions.gloss: small accessory case; trinket box; catch-all container
definitions.explanation: A container, pouch, or box designed to hold small personal items such as keys, coins, stationery, or accessories.

examples.japanese: {鍵|かぎ}は{小物|こもの}{入|い}れに{入|い}れてある。
examples.english: The keys are in the trinket box.

examples.japanese: {革|かわ}の{小物|こもの}{入|い}れを{誕生日|たんじょうび}にもらった。
examples.english: I received a leather accessory case for my birthday.

examples.japanese: {玄関|げんかん}に{小物|こもの}{入|い}れを{置|お}いておくと、{鍵|かぎ}や{定期券|ていきけん}をなくさなくて{済|す}む。
examples.english: If you keep a catch-all by the entrance, you won't lose your keys or commuter pass.

notes:
Composed of {小物|こもの} (small items; accessories) + {入|い}れ (container; holder). Refers to any container designed for organizing small personal belongings. Can range from a simple tray on a desk to a zippered pouch in a bag.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {革|かわ}の{小物|こもの}{入|い}れ: leather accessory case
- {小物|こもの}{入|い}れポーチ: small accessory pouch
- {小物|こもの}{入|い}れに{入|い}れる: to put in the catch-all

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ポーチ: pouch — a loanword often used for cosmetic or travel pouches
- {小物|こもの}{入|い}れ{箱|ばこ}: small items box — specifically a box rather than a pouch or tray
- {筆|ふで}{箱|ばこ}: pencil case — specifically for writing implements
